records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Kickoff held (calendar:41533c8d) but no customer reply to three outreaches (email:831e0e59, ca3f9970, a1ef3873), no project, no invite, no tickets at day 6. Sustained silence after a live call suggests low unaided momentum, though 8 days remain and a Starter admin can self-serve.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on, so I'll keep this short: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm glad to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you, using whatever workflow you're carrying over from your old tool.

Best,
Nadia
